compat_notes: BASE plan picks provider 'node' because of package.json: install 'npm install', build 'npm run build', start 'node index.js'. On Node 24 the install fails (node-sass 6), and 'node index.js' throws 'ReferenceError: document is not defined' (index.js is browser DOM code). A one-line root Staticfile ('root: .') scores 50 in anybuild 0.33.1 detection (crates/anybuild/src/providers/mod.rs) against node's 10-45, so PATCHED plans provider staticfile, static_dir '.', no install or build. The CSS uses url(../../assets/svg/common-bg.svg) from css/style.css, which resolves to /assets/... only when served at the site root (fine on a root deployment; verified in the browser).
caveats: Contact form is UI only: index.html has <form action="#">, unconfigured, so submissions go nowhere until the user configures it (README suggests formspree.io; Netlify forms are Netlify-only). Google Fonts load externally from fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com. The static root '.' also serves repository files (README.md, LICENSE, package.json, package-lock.json, sass/, Staticfile); they are already public in the repo. Users who change SASS must commit the compiled css/style.css (upstream's 'npm run build' prefixing/minifying is not run on Wasmer; the unprefixed committed CSS rendered correctly in Chromium). Root-relative CSS asset path (../../assets) assumes a root deployment. Placeholder identity (John Doe) and '#' social links. No analytics or third-party IDs found in the pages.
